results.heading: Cancellation policy
results.text: Appointments can be cancelled or rescheduled free of charge up to 24 hours before the appointment time. Cancellations with less than 24 hours' notice, and missed appointments, are charged ₺500.

results.heading: Insurance
results.text: We work with Allianz, AXA and Anadolu Sigorta private health policies. Bring your policy number; we check coverage before treatment and bill the insurer directly where the policy allows it.

results.heading: Booking an appointment
results.text: New and existing patients can book by email or phone. Tell us what the visit is for (check-up, pain, hygiene, whitening) and two or three preferred days; reception confirms a time.

args.subject: Re: Can we move my Wednesday appointment to next week?
args.body:
Dear Gabel,

Thank you for your message. Your current appointment is on Wednesday 21 October at 13:30, and it is more than 24 hours away.

On Wednesday 28 October, these times are free: 14:00, 14:30, 15:30, 16:00 and 17:30. The 13:30 slot is not available that day, so I have not made a change yet.

Reply with the time you prefer, and our reception will confirm the move. Rescheduling is free of charge up to 24 hours before the appointment (see cancellation policy, chunk cancellation#cancellation-policy).

Warm regards,
Nova Dental Clinic reception
